page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a dedicated CPU allocation. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a low memory-to-core ratio of 1.0 GB per core. There is no bundled local storage or GPU hardware included with this instance type.

A key technical constraint of the ecs.s3.medium is the absence of advanced CPU instruction sets. The processor lacks support for Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-accelerated cryptography (AES, SHA). This lack of vector and cryptographic extensions limits its performance in mathematical modeling, encryption, and modern database operations. Additionally, the 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to gigabytes of RAM restricts the execution of memory-heavy processes.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a dedicated CPU allocation at a budget-friendly tier, making it suitable for compute-focused workloads that do not require large memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web serving, basic microservices, task queuing, and simple utility scripts. It is not suited for data analytics, machine learning, or memory-intensive database hosting.
